    From the CounterQuick Stop nacho cheese dipSmooth melted cheddar dip with a pinch of chilli, corn chips to dunkHow to make it250g cheddar, grated1 tbsp cornflour375ml evaporated milk1 pinch chilli powder230g corn chipsToss the cheddar with the cornflour.Heat the evaporated milk until steaming, then stir in the cheese a handful at a time over low heat until smooth.Season with a pinch of chilli and keep warm. Serve with corn chips for dunking.Doctor's orders crudités with green goddessCarrot, celery, cucumber and snow peas around a herby avocado yoghurt dip, chilled crispHow to make itNot on tonight's cookCrisp carrot, celery, cucumber, capsicum and snow peas around a bright green goddess dip of herbs, yoghurt, avocado and lemon.Blitz 1 avocado, 150g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp mayo, a big handful each of parsley, basil and chives, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt until smooth and bright green.Chill.Cut 2 carrots, 3 celery sticks, 1 cucumber and 1 red capsicum into batons and trim 150g snow peas.Stand the vegetables in iced water for 10 minutes, drain well and arrange around the dip.Roller grill hot dogs with mustardI'm not even supposed to be here today.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.PlatesRST Video pork roll, egg and cheeseFried pork roll, fried egg and American cheese on a soft rollHow to make it400g pork roll, in 8 slices4 eggs4 slices of American cheese4 soft rolls4 tbsp tomato saucesalt and pepper, to tasteNick the edges of the pork roll slices and fry until curled and browned.Fry the eggs.Stack pork roll, egg and cheese into the rolls, add tomato sauce, salt and pepper.Wrap in foil for a couple of minutes to melt.Chicken parm heroesChicken parm in a roll, lunch on the Inconvenience setHow to make itNot on tonight's cookCrumbed chicken fried golden, topped with marinara and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling and stuffed into toasted long rolls with basil.Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm.Coat in flour, beaten egg and 120g breadcrumbs mixed with 30g grated parmesan.Shallow fry in oil 3 minutes a side until golden.Simmer 400g passata with 1 garlic clove and oregano for 10 minutes.Put the chicken on a tray, spoon over sauce, top with 200g grated mozzarella and grill 3 minutes until bubbling.Tuck into 4 toasted long rolls with basil leaves.The Cake CaseQuick Stop coffee cakeEmma lends Dante thirty grand. Walnut swirlHow to make it125g butter, softened200g caster sugar2 eggs250g sour cream300g self-raising flour80g walnuts, chopped50g brown sugar2 tsp ground cinnamonBeat the butter and sugar, add the eggs and sour cream, then fold in the flour.Mix the walnuts with the brown sugar and cinnamon.Layer half the batter, the walnut mix, then the rest in a greased ring tin.Bake at 175°C.Cool before turning out.Buddy Christ crumb cake squaresElias and Blockchain sell Buddy Christ kites. Cinnamon crumbHow to make it100g butter, cold, for the crumb150g self-raising flour, for the crumb100g brown sugar2 tsp ground cinnamon100g butter, softened, for the cake100g caster sugar2 eggs200g self-raising flour, for the cake100ml milk2 tbsp icing sugarRub the cold butter into the crumb flour, brown sugar and cinnamon.Beat the soft butter with the sugar, eggs, flour and milk and spread in a lined tin.Cover with the crumb and bake at 175°C.Cool and dust with icing sugar.CupsBlack and white cold brewSilent Bob shoots it in black and white. Cream on topHow to make it100g coarsely ground coffee800ml cold water150ml thickened cream200ml milk1 tbsp brown sugar1/2 tsp ground cinnamon4 cups iceStir the coffee into the water and leave in the fridge overnight, which is the resting time.Strain through a sieve lined with a paper towel.Whisk the cream with a little of the milk, the brown sugar and cinnamon until thick but pourable.Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in cold brew and a splash of milk, then spoon the cinnamon foam on top.Iced green teaIced tea for the man who just had a heart attack.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
